verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs say OCR works "even from low-quality or handwritten sources." They also document confidence scores at page, block, or word granularity, and the annotations feature extracts fields into a user-defined JSON format. A community user reports digitizing handwritten forms with high accuracy, with only a small share needing human review. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on handwriting recognition (it is a single line), explicit handling of handwritten marginal annotations, and a built-in uncertainty flag or threshold rather than raw confidence scores the developer must threshold.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain
